evals.prompt: 我的 mac 最近太热了，风扇声音很大。帮我诊断一下发热原因，并生成一个交互式 HTML 报告：要能看到最占资源的进程、能按 CPU 排序、能搜索进程名，还要有一个可以勾选和复制成 markdown 的行动清单。注意信息不要一次全铺出来，结论要一眼看到。
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained interactive HTML file: verdict-first line under title, searchable + sortable process table, checkable action list with copy-to-markdown button, evidence collapsed or on-demand, provenance footer. Saved to outputs/.
expectations: Output is a single self-contained HTML file with no external <script>/<link> resources
The page shows a verdict-first line directly under the title, before any tables
The process table is searchable via an input that filters rows
The process table columns are sortable by clicking headers
There is a checkable action checklist with a copy-to-markdown button
Evidence/details sections are collapsed or loaded on demand, not all expanded at once
A provenance footer records source and generation info

evals.prompt: 我上个月做的项目验收报告 HTML 太臃肿了，一个页面有 6 个大 tab、每 tab 都是几十行表格，评审说看不动。帮我把这份报告重做成一个精炼的交互式单页：结论放最上面，细节折叠起来，但搜索、筛选、可点击的条目、勾选清单这些交互一个都不能丢。
evals.expected_output: A redesigned single-page HTML: one-line verdict first, details behind collapsible sections or on-demand filters, ALL interactive affordances preserved (search / sort / clickable rows / checklist / copy), self-contained. Saved to outputs/.
expectations: Output is a single self-contained HTML file
The first visible content is a one-line verdict, not a table
Bulk detail content sits behind collapsible sections or on-demand filters
Search, sort, clickable rows, checklist, and copy affordances all still function
No section renders its full data table expanded on page load

evals.prompt: 帮我做一份 MySQL 慢查询性能诊断报告（虚构数据即可）。数据量很大：Top 20 慢 SQL 明细、每条的执行计划分析、索引建议、周趋势图表、还有一份给 DBA 的行动清单。内容太多一个页面装不下，我想先看总结论，然后按需点开每个部分的详细内容。请生成完整的 HTML 交付物。
evals.expected_output: A multi-page HTML deliverable: a lightweight main.html with verdict-first + one-line summary per section + links/iframes to sub pages; separate sub HTML files (one per section: top-sql detail, execution plans, index advice, trend charts, action checklist), each self-contained and independently openable; relative-path links so it works offline; main stays lean (<50KB), sub content NOT inlined into main. Saved to outputs/.
expectations: Output produces a main.html plus multiple sub-*.html files, not one monolith
main.html is verdict-first with a one-line summary per section
main.html references sub pages via relative-path links or iframes
Each sub HTML is self-contained and independently openable
main.html stays under 50KB and does not inline sub content
Opening the deliverable offline from a local folder shows all pages

evals.prompt: 我手上有一个设计师交付的 500KB 单文件 SPA 原型（hash 路由，三个导航视图 chat/experts/projects，fixed 侧边栏布局），我改了 4 处：① 侧边栏 AI 对话导航加 NEW 徽章 ② 品牌区加版本号 ③ 专家团视图里「供应链经营总控」卡片加新技能徽章 ④ 项目组视图里「Q3 交付保障」卡片加里程碑徽章。请给这个原型做一个改动预览：打开文件先看到改动总览，点击任意一处能定位到改动处（包括需要先切换视图的子视图改动），评审可以勾选确认并复制 Markdown 清单。
evals.expected_output: A changes-preview injected into the single-file SPA: (1) a fixed top bar, default collapsed to a single slim row (<40px) with verdict 'N 处改动' + one clickable tag per change; expandable to show detail rows with summary + jump link + checkbox + copy-markdown; (2) each change marked with id=chg-N badge in the RENDER TEMPLATE (not static HTML) so it survives view switching; (3) jump logic handles sub-view changes: if element not present, click the corresponding nav (experts/projects), poll-wait for render (150ms interval), then locate; (4) locating uses flash animation + persistent outline (chg-located), NOT hash anchors (avoid SPA route hijack) and NOT relying on scrollIntoView alone; (5) switching target clears previous locate state; (6) zero console errors, original nav switching still works.
expectations: The SPA has a fixed changes bar, default collapsed to one slim row under 40px tall
Collapsed bar shows 'N 处改动' verdict plus one clickable tag per change
Expanded bar shows per-change rows with summary + jump link + checkbox + copy-markdown
Each change is marked with an id=chg-N badge injected in the render template, surviving view switching
Jumping to a change in another sub-view clicks the nav and waits for render before locating
Locating uses flash animation + persistent outline, not hash anchors or scrollIntoView alone
Switching target clears the previous locate highlight
Original nav switching still works with zero console errors

evals.prompt: 为这次会话做一个交互式 Onepager recap。聊天记录明确提到本次 fresh UAT 生成了 report.html、qa.json、run.webm、trace.zip；这些文件都在输入目录。请不要等我逐个点名，主动归集本次会话产物，并把重要产物直接放进主页面。来源项目绝对路径写 /tmp/pitch-video-project，Pi session ID 写 eval-session-5。
evals.expected_output: A main session recap HTML that proactively discovers the four evidenced artifacts, directly links all of them, and visibly embeds the primary video player outside collapsed details.
expectations: The main HTML contains direct links to report.html, qa.json, run.webm, and trace.zip using real relative paths.
The primary video run.webm is visible in the main body through a video element with controls and is not only inside a details element.
The output does not invent links or include unrelated artifacts that were not provided by the prompt or fixture directory.
The page includes source project absolute path and a Pi session ID in its footer.

evals.prompt: 请把本次调试会话总结成 onepager。当前聊天提到两个视频：最终成功录像 run.webm 和失败证据 failure.webm，还有最终报告 report.html。它们位于输入目录；hero.svg 是页面素材。主页面应让我一眼看到最终录像和所有会话产物入口，不要把视频只藏在“证据”折叠区。来源项目绝对路径 /tmp/debug-session，session ID eval-session-6。
evals.expected_output: A recap with a visible primary run.webm player, direct entries for both videos and report, and hero.svg rendered inline rather than treated as an unrelated session deliverable.
expectations: The primary video run.webm is visible in the main body through a video element with controls and is not only inside a details element.
The main HTML directly links both run.webm and failure.webm and report.html, while hero.svg is inline or used as page artwork rather than omitted silently.
The output does not invent links or include unrelated artifacts that were not provided by the prompt or fixture directory.
The page includes source project absolute path and a Pi session ID in its footer.

evals.prompt: 生成一个本次会话 handoff Onepager。聊天只确认产物 qa.json；输入目录里还存在旧会话的 failure.webm，但聊天没有把它归属到当前会话。请主动收集有证据的当前会话产物，同时避免把目录里所有文件都塞进页面。来源项目绝对路径 /tmp/scoped-handoff，session ID eval-session-7。
evals.expected_output: A scoped handoff that links qa.json, does not include the unrelated failure.webm, and states the artifact set honestly.
expectations: The main HTML directly links qa.json.
The main HTML does not link or copy failure.webm because the prompt says it belongs to an old session.
The page does not invent any artifact URL or placeholder link.
The footer includes /tmp/scoped-handoff and eval-session-7.

evals.prompt: Read the attached Pi transcript and create the requested session recap Onepager. Follow the transcript’s final user request.
evals.expected_output: Without being explicitly asked to collect artifacts, the recap discovers all session-produced outputs from the transcript, presents direct links, and makes the primary video visible.
expectations: The main HTML directly links report.html, qa.json, run.webm, and trace.zip using portable relative paths.
run.webm is rendered in a controls-enabled video player outside any details element.
The artifact links are visible in the main page rather than present only inside collapsed details.
The footer includes /tmp/pitch-video and implicit-session-8.

evals.prompt: Read the attached Pi transcript and create the requested handoff Onepager. Follow the transcript’s final user request.
evals.expected_output: The recap proactively links current-report.html and current-qa.json but does not import the globally listed old-session video.
expectations: The main HTML directly links current-report.html and current-qa.json.
The output does not link or copy old-failure.webm.
The artifact links are visible in the main page rather than present only inside collapsed details.
The footer includes /tmp/scoped-recap and implicit-session-9.

evals.prompt: Read the attached Pi transcript and create the requested concise session recap Onepager. Follow the transcript’s final user request.
evals.expected_output: The recap explicitly states that no independent sub-artifacts were produced instead of silently omitting the artifact gateway or inventing links.
expectations: The main HTML explicitly states that this session produced no independent sub-artifacts.
The main HTML contains no artifact download or placeholder links.
The footer includes /tmp/no-artifacts and implicit-session-10.

evals.prompt: 为一个 AI 专家 WebApp 做一份 onepager，说明它有两种使用路径：路径 A 用 GUI 表单驱动（表单阶段零后端调用、审阅按 Enter 才执行、发布后走专家 API），路径 B 直接与 expert-creator / expert-fixer 专家纯对话（无表单、自然语言创建或改进技能）。两条路径最终都汇合到「已发布专家 + evals 快照」。请给出单文件交互式 HTML，用内联 SVG 把两条路径都画出来，每条路径的界面 mock 卡片要标注路径徽标，并说明两条路径在表单/执行/发布环节的异同。
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained interactive HTML: an overview SVG showing both paths from a shared business need branching into path A (GUI form → review Enter → publish → POST /responses) and path B (pure chat with expert-creator / expert-fixer) converging on 'published expert + evals snapshot'; each screen mock card carries a path badge (A / B / A+B); a table contrasting the two paths on form stage, execution stage, and publish; all SVG inline, no external resources.
expectations: Output is a single self-contained HTML file with no external script/link/img resources
An overview SVG branches a shared entry point into path A and path B and converges on published expert + evals snapshot
Each screen mock card is labeled with a path badge (A, B, or A+B)
A contrast table distinguishes the two paths on form stage (form vs chat), execution, and publish
All SVG is inline, with zero external assets

evals.prompt: 我的一份 onepager HTML 里的内联 SVG 只渲染出了最外层外框和标题，下面一大片区域全空白。代码里 SVG 的徽标用了 <span> 包裹、<text> 里还嵌了 <code>。请修复这个 HTML，让它整个 SVG 都正常渲染，并确保同类问题不再出现。
evals.expected_output: A fixed single-file HTML where the inline SVG renders completely: badge wrappers inside SVG use <g> instead of <span>, <text> content has no <code>/other HTML element inside it, no element in the SVG relies on HTML foreign-content mode. The full SVG (all paths, boxes, badges, arrows) is visible.
expectations: The HTML contains no <span> or <code> element inside any <svg> block
Badge wrappers inside SVG use <g> elements
SVG <text> nodes contain plain text only, no nested HTML elements
The full SVG renders visibly (not just the outer box and title), verified via screenshot or pixel check
The file remains self-contained with zero external resources
